Figure 1:Task-efficient software-agent evaluation. Representative strategies
estimate full-benchmark scores from limited target executions. HSPR combines
hierarchical response modeling with adaptive querying. The displayed median
is the decision before source-selected calibration.

Figure 2:HSPR evaluation pipeline. Source responses provide fitted
response factors and source-signature groups. Sequential queries update
the posteriors over the target latent state and group success rates.
Observed successes and posterior-predictive success counts for unqueried
tasks define the full-score posterior used for the final calibrated estimate.
